# Space and Tech Engineering LLP

> Made in India drone components. Space and Tech Engineering LLP is an Indian drone electronics company with offices in India. It designs and sells the Aazmuth and Exelr8 flight controllers, Skydrive AM32 ESCs and NAVSATE GPS modules for UAV and FPV builders.

Key facts:
- Products: Aazmuth and Exelr8 flight controllers, Skydrive AM32 ESCs (40A, 60A, 55A 4-in-1), NAVSATE GPS modules.
- Offices: India (registered office and product development centre).
- Use cases: agriculture, survey and mapping, defence and industrial, FPV racing, education, startups.
- OEM and bulk orders: arup@spaceandtech-engineerings.com, +91 96657 17903.

## Products
- [Aazmuth flight controller](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/aazmuth-flight-controller.html): Modular, triple-redundant STM32 H7 flight controller with 3 IMUs and 2 barometers on isolated buses.
- [Exelr8 FPV flight controller F7](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/exelr8-fpv-flight-controller-f7.html): F7 flight controller for light, fast FPV racing and freestyle builds.
- [Skydrive AM32 60A 3-6S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/skydrive-am32-60a.html): 60A AM32 ESC for 3-6S LiPo builds. Handles heavy payloads such as sprayer drones.
- [NAVSATE GPS for UAVs](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/navsate-gps-for-uavs.html): UAV-tuned GPS module, tested on long flights, for position hold and waypoint missions.
- [NAVSATE mini for FPV drones](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/navsate-mini-gps.html): Compact NAVSATE GPS for FPV drones. Adds position data to small builds.
- [ELRS FPV radio receiver](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/elrs-fpv-receiver.html): ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz receiver with ESP32, CRSF output and built-in TCXO for FPV aircraft.
- [4-in-1 ESC 80A 3-6S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/sate-4-in-1-esc-80a.html): Four-channel FPV ESC on one board with AM32 support, DShot and 3-6S input.
- [SATE-HIGH AMP ESC 200A 6-12S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/sate-high-amp-esc.html): High-current single ESC with 200A continuous rating, 6S-12S input and AM32 support.
- [SATE-AIO Board](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/sate-aio-board.html): All-in-one flight controller and 4-in-1 ESC board, up to 25A continuous, AM32 and DShot.
- [Kinetik Flight Controller](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/kinetik-flight-controller.html): Compact 5×5 cm FPV flight controller with dual Betaflight and ArduPilot support for versatile drone applications.
